summary: The change to release() in payments.py replaces the unconditional idempotency guard ('if previous is not None: return previous') with a time-windowed check that only short-circuits within 1 day. After 24 hours, a replay of the same instruction_id will fall through and invoke _send_disbursement, producing a second disbursement—directly violating PAY-2 ('releasing the same payment instruction again never sends a second disbursement'). The acceptance-ledger evidence for PAY-2 (ACR-0403) lapses under LAP-1 because the covered symbol's behaviour is altered, and no new evidence is supplied. No valid exception in the register covers this deviation. All process obligations (ticket, independent approval, approval-on-head, CI on final commit) are satisfied, and PAY-1 and MC-1 remain intact because their covered symbols are unchanged, but the PAY-2 violation is critical and cannot be accepted.
